# Baseball Through the Years

Using the Lahman database, this site explores the history of Major League Baseball through its data. Season totals can make shortened schedules look like dramatic home-run collapses; comparing home runs per team-game gives a fairer view of how hitting changed.

The Sluggers page highlights career home-run leaders and follows Barry Bonds season by season. Use the analysis pages in the navbar to explore the charts and comparisons.
